instruction: I want to organize the assessment criteria questions into a bulleted list format. Please convert all the question paragraphs (the ones starting with 'Do', 'Can', etc. under the presentation, discussion, and debate sections) into bulleted list items to improve their visual organization.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting 11 question paragraphs into bulleted list items. Evaluator counts paragraphs with list/bullet style applied. Expected count: 11.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is fragile: relies on style name pattern matching ('List' prefix or 'bullet' substring) which may not capture all bulleted paragraphs in LibreOffice Writer
LibreOffice DOCX uses actual numbering properties (w:numPr in XML) to define list formatting, not just style names - direct formatting bullets would be missed
Style names may vary (e.g., 'List Paragraph', 'Bullet List', language-specific names) causing false negatives
The detection method doesn't verify actual bullet/numbering formatting - only checks style name strings
Expected count of 11 appears reasonable based on task description
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter should check paragraph._element for w:numPr (numbering properties) to detect actual list formatting, not just style names
Alternative: check if para._p.pPr.numPr exists to verify numbering is applied
Consider using python-docx's paragraph formatting properties to detect list levels
Add fallback: if numPr exists OR style name matches list pattern, count as bulleted paragraph
